_about: Public-domain Johannes Brenz (1499-1570), reformer of Schwabisch Hall and Wurttemberg, for the Word Hoard: Newes from Niniue to Englande, his exposition of Jonah translated by Thomas Tymme (catalogued 1570), and A Verye Fruitful Exposicion upon the Syxte Chapter of Saynte John, in ten homilies, translated by Richard Shirrye (catalogued 1550), from Internet Archive scans of Early English Books (black letter, rough OCR). Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

brenz-exposicion-john-vi-1550: A Verye Fruitful Exposicion upon the Syxte Chapter of Saynte John, divided into x Homelies or Sermons, written in Latin by Master John Brencius and translated into Englishe by Richarde Shirrye, Londoner (catalogued 1550)
brenz-newes-niniue-1570: Newes from Niniue to Englande, brought by the Prophete Ionas, his exposition of Jonah, translated out of Latine by Thomas Tymme (London: Henrie Denham; catalogued 1570)

_excluded.brenz-other: His Latin, German, Dutch and Danish printings; Pressel's Anecdota Brentiana (1868); the Wurttemberg Confession (German, 1848)
